Undisclosed US test site

Restricted airspace

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Gate-malfunction event
RFID/fob: opened on 4th try
after 3 partial failures
Сбой ворот непосредственно перед наблюдением

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3-vehicle convoy
Колонна из 3 машин
Sr3=vehicle 1 lead
Sr4=vehicle 2 contractor
Sr5=vehicle 3

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FBI-ELLIPSE-Sr3
Lead witness — ~15 yrs at facility
Ведущий свидетель — ~15 лет на объекте
2 of 2 pages released
Полный двухстраничный narrative
verbatim morphology, color, motion,
silence, instant disappearance,
no EM interference

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FBI-ELLIPSE-Sr4
Contractor — vehicle 2
Контрактник — машина 2
page 2 only — page 1 WITHHELD
Только стр.2 — стр.1 СКРЫТА
independent EM-null confirmation,
delayed psychological aftereffects

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FBI-ELLIPSE-Sr5
Third witness — vehicle 3
Третий свидетель — машина 3
page 2 only — page 1 WITHHELD
Только стр.2 — стр.1 СКРЫТА
single substantive sentence:
'bright light over horizon'
'might have been a meteor'

Size: 130–195 ft

Размер: 130–195 футов

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
'Intense diamond white light'
with ring on east end
'Алмазно-белый свет' с кольцом

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Completely silent
during 5–10 sec observation
Полное безмолвие

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Instant disappearance
no acceleration phase
Мгновенное исчезновение

span.p:
NO EM interference
(Sr3 + independent Sr4 confirm)
Никаких ЭМ-помех

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

FBI-ELLIPSE-SKETCH-2023
FBI Laboratory composite
superimposed on actual site photo
Композит на реальном фото площадки
filename date 2024-04-30 = production,
NOT incident date

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
130–195 ft size range
= formalisation of Sr3 verbal estimate
(NOT independent measurement)
≠ радар, сенсор, фотограмметрия

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
'Materialized out of a bright light'
'Материализовался из яркого света'
NOT in extracted Sr3 narrative
Likely source: Sr5's withheld page 1

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sr4 + Sr5 page 1 narratives
(systematic withholding pattern)
(systemic, not random redaction)

None referenced in release

Никаких фото свидетелей
